title: Brighter studio portraits, wardrobe and motion refinements
description: More consistent lighting across viewing angles, stable spin jumps, restored idle transitions and wardrobe corrections.
highlights: Softer studio lighting follows the view, with clearer upright faces and independent fill lighting for all five avatars.
360 Power Spin Jump stays in place, with a stable view from takeoff to landing.
Boxing Warm-up and Happy Sway Standing retain a supported stance and independent foot movement.
Restored changing idle poses in solo and Together mode.
Corrected Ming-Mei’s eyebrow tint, Sarah’s fitted clothing and Iselda’s skirt support.
Restored the pilot’s covered limbs in open armor and kept the head aligned inside closed helmets.
Updated encrypted wardrobe and motion downloads; appearance, voices and account settings are retained.
